title: Subjunctive & formal hypothesising
note: demand/insist/suggest that + base; were to; lest · thin shell night/2026-08-05

items.en: I suggest that he leave immediately.
accepts: I suggest that he leave immediately.

items.en: It is essential that she be present.
items.gap: It is essential that she ____ present.
accepts: It is essential that she be present.
items.explanation: be for all persons in formal that-clauses.

items.en: The board demanded that the report be rewritten.
items.cz: Rada požadovala, aby zpráva byla přepsána.
items.gap: The board demanded that the report ____ rewritten.
accepts: The board demanded that the report be rewritten.

items.en: If I were to resign, who would replace me?
items.cz: Kdybych rezignoval, kdo by mě nahradil?
items.gap: If I ____ to resign, who would replace me?
accepts: If I were to resign, who would replace me?

items.en: She insisted that the meeting start on time.
items.cz: Trvala na tom, aby schůzka začala včas.
items.gap: She insisted that the meeting ____ on time.
accepts: She insisted that the meeting start on time.

items.en: They recommended that he be promoted.
accepts: They recommended that he be promoted.

items.en: Whether it be rain or shine, we go.
items.cz: Ať prší nebo svítí slunce, jdeme.
items.gap: Whether it ____ rain or shine, we go.
accepts: Whether it be rain or shine, we go.

items.en: He spoke as if he were an expert.
items.gap: He spoke as if he ____ an expert.
accepts: He spoke as if he were an expert.

items.en: The law requires that every citizen pay tax.
items.cz: Zákon vyžaduje, aby každý občan platil daň.
items.gap: The law requires that every citizen ____ tax.
accepts: The law requires that every citizen pay tax.
